install-local: if [ "$resolved" != "$install_path" ]; then echo "WARNING: your shell currently resolves jjw as: ${resolved:-not found}"; echo "Add $install_dir before other entries in PATH, then run 'hash -r' in bash or 'rehash' in zsh."; fi
echo "For cd-on-open/create/close/main, add 'eval \"$(jjw shell-init zsh)\"' to ~/.zshrc or 'eval \"$(jjw shell-init bash)\"' to ~/.bashrc."
